senses.gloss: m. (חול; v. חוֹל III) outsider, stranger, non-priest, non-Israelite.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 24:2">Targ. Is. XXIV, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 29:33">Targ. Ex. XXIX, 33</cite> (O. ed. Amst. <he>נַיָּא …</he>, incorr.); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="H00766"><he>חִילוֹנָאֵי</he></cite>.
Targ. Y. Deut. XXIII, 3 (not חוֹל׳).—Fem. חִילוֹנִיתָא.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 137:4">Targ. Ps. CXXXVII, 4</cite> <he>ארעא ח׳</he> unholy land.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 2:16">Targ. Prov. II, 16</cite> (Ms. <cite ref="H00768"><he>חִילוֹנְיֵיתָא</he></cite>).
